name: llmtab
description: Local-first LLM token usage & cost tracker for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, ZCode and Ollama.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n cli,dashboard -c blue,green "npm run build:cli -- --watch" "npm run dev --workspace dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.build:cli: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/cost/assets',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('src/cost/assets/pricing-snapshot.json','dist/cost/assets/pricing-snapshot.json');for(const f of ['icon-512.png','icon-256.png','tray-16.png','tray-32.png','LLMTab.icns']){try{fs.mkdirSync('dist/icons',{recursive:true});const s='build/icons/'+f;if(fs.existsSync(s))fs.copyFileSync(s,'dist/icons/'+f);}catch{}}"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace dashboard
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build

author: naninanides
